crossRefs.note: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…
“To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:
Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.

people.name: Ehud
people.line: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

translations.web: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
translations.bsb: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged sword a cubit long. He strapped it to his right thigh under his cloak
translations.kjv: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
translations.asv: And Ehud made him a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he girded it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
